entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 bchba_be returns zero for the synthetic German-speaking Community newborn coded drgn1=4. The BE.xml birth-allowance conditions enumerate drgn1=1, 2, and 3 newborn branches only — no drgn1=4 branch exists — while Brussels, Flanders, and Wallonia newborn cases in the same suite match exactly. The source-backed RuleSpec returns the official DG birth premium of 1376.16 EUR (Article 30 premium of 1144 EUR before indexation, current amount from the Ostbelgien family-benefits surface). Verified deterministic (2026-07-05 batch-size-1 audit): the DG zero persists at --comparison-batch-size 1 and across ten identical DG households in one run (all 0.0), while the Brussels control pays bchba_s=1367.74 in isolation — a genuine regional coverage gap, not batch-position contamination.
